# Search of hospital with Pronto Soccorso

### Set working directory

```{r Work Director, include=FALSE}
'set working directory'
'consiglio di usare GitHub per lo script'

# Calcola il percorso della cartella padre
parent_dir <- dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))

# Imposta il root.dir con knitr
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = parent_dir)

# Verifica il risultato
setwd(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"))
getwd()
```

```{r Libraries, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r Dataset, include=FALSE}
#setwd(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"))
grid_points <- read.csv('tempi_percorrenza_centroidi_ps.csv') %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("grid_longitude", "grid_latitude"), crs = 4326)
middle_points_istat <- read.csv('dati_istat_pop_1km2.csv') %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

```

```{r}
table1_with_table2 <- st_join(grid_points, middle_points_istat, join = st_nearest_feature)
```

```{r}
table1_with_table2
```

```{r}
table1_with_table2 <- table1_with_table2 %>%
  select(-OBJECTID, -GRD_ID, -CNTR_ID, )
```

```{r}

# 💾 Save the final merged table


st_write(table1_with_table2, "merged_table.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)



table1_with_table2 <- table1_with_table2 %>%
  mutate(latitude = st_coordinates(table1_with_table2)[, 2],  # Latitude is the second column
         longitude = st_coordinates(table1_with_table2)[, 1])  # Longitude is the first column

write.csv(st_drop_geometry(table1_with_table2), "merged_table_with_lat_lon.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
table1_with_people <- table1_with_table2 %>%
  filter(TOT_P_2021 != 0)

```

```{r}
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(TOT_P_2021 = ceiling(TOT_P_2021 / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(M = ceiling(M / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(F = ceiling(F / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(Y_LT15 = ceiling(Y_LT15 / 4))

table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(Y1564 = ceiling(Y1564 / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(Y_GE65 = ceiling(Y_GE65 / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(NAT = ceiling(NAT / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(EU_OTH = ceiling(EU_OTH / 4))

table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(OTH = ceiling(OTH / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(EMP = ceiling(EMP / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(SAME = ceiling(SAME / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(CHG_IN = ceiling(CHG_IN / 4))
table1_with_people <- table1_with_people %>%
  mutate(CHG_OUT = ceiling(CHG_OUT / 4))
```

\

```{r}

# 💾 Save the resulting table as CSV
write.csv(st_drop_geometry(table1_with_people), "points_with_people.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 💾 Save the resulting table as GeoPackage (GPKG)
st_write(table1_with_people, "points_with_people.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)

```
